mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.biz_id AS answerId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.biz_type = 2 AND c.biz_id = #{answerId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.biz_id AS kbEntryId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM qa_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.biz_type = 4 AND c.biz_id = #{kbEntryId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
